The strategy for this policy

- Quickly detect immediate wins for ourselves (bridge, fork, ring) and play them.
- Always block opponent immediate wins when possible.
- Otherwise score every legal move using a heuristic that balances:
  - connecting to our existing groups (favor moves that touch our stones),
  - disrupting opponent connections (favor moves adjacent to opponent stones),
  - proximity to corners and edges (to build bridges/forks),
  - central control (prefer center when no urgent threats).
- The policy builds an internal hex-neighbor graph from the provided square-grid representation, identifies the six corners and the boundary cycle (so edges are recognized), and uses lightweight graph checks to detect bridges (component touches >=2 corners), forks (component touches >=3 distinct edges), and rings (component contains a cycle). These checks are fast and accurate enough to catch immediate winning moves.
- The evaluation is deterministic (tie-breaking uses a hash of current positions), so the policy is consistent.
